clue.text: One is unable to tuck into beer in Spain

indicators.note: to tuck something into a thing is to put it inside, so the beer word holds the other pieces

parts.note: ale is a kind of beer
one is the Roman numeral I
is unable means can't, written CANT

explanation.surface: A drinker, unable to manage it, fails to get into a beer while holidaying in Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: Alicante is a port city on the south-east coast of Spain, so it is a place found there.

clue.text: Pick up king's knight

parts.note: Lear is Shakespeare's king, and the 's joins him to the next piece
N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: A chess player picks up the king's knight from the board.
explanation.definitionFit: To pick up a skill or fact is to acquire it, a common informal synonym.

clue.text: Reticent prisoners studied

parts.note: cons is short for convicts, that is prisoners
trained means schooled or studied

explanation.surface: A report on prisoners who were quiet and studious behind bars.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone reticent holds back, behaving in a restricted, held-in manner.

clue.text: Raymond foolishly supported knight in France

indicators.note: in a down answer, the reshuffled name holds up the knight letter placed above it

parts.note: N is the chess notation for a knight

indicators.note: acting foolishly suggests disorder, so the name's letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Raymond, rather unwisely, backed a knight in a medieval tale set in France.
explanation.definitionFit: Normandy is a region of northern France, so it lies in that country.

clue.text: Treating the rash wrongly is fateful

indicators.note: done wrongly suggests something set out in the wrong order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Mistreating a skin rash could turn out to have serious consequences.
explanation.definitionFit: Something momentous enough to shake the world is fateful, a loose synonym for hugely significant.

clue.text: Note about the lowest possible degrees

parts.note: a minim is a musical note, a half note
a. is an abbreviation for about, approximately

explanation.surface: A musician writes a note about just how little effort will do.
explanation.definitionFit: Minima is the plural of minimum, the smallest possible amounts or levels.

clue.text: Current in the way of the navy

parts.note: a mode is a way or manner of doing something
RN stands for the Royal Navy

explanation.surface: A remark that something is currently the way the navy does things.
explanation.definitionFit: Current and modern both describe what belongs to the present day.

clue.text: A number turned up in trap

indicators.note: in a down answer, turned up means the word is read from the bottom upward

parts.note: ten is a number

explanation.surface: A certain number of animals turned up in a trap.
explanation.definitionFit: A net is a mesh device used to catch animals or fish, a kind of trap.

clue.text: A greater number showed up round British resort

parts.note: more means a greater number

indicators.note: round means the arrival word is wrapped about the single letter

parts.note: came means arrived or showed up

explanation.surface: Even more holidaymakers arrived around a British seaside town.
explanation.definitionFit: Morecambe is a seaside resort town in Lancashire, north-west England, on Morecambe Bay.

clue.text: Speculate about northern composer

indicators.note: about means the betting word goes around the single letter

parts.note: to wager is to bet or speculate

explanation.surface: People speculate about a composer from the north.
explanation.definitionFit: Richard Wagner was a German composer known for operas such as the Ring cycle.

clue.text: Winger trots towards strumpet

parts.note: Trots, short for Trotskyists, are left-wingers, informally reds
tart is a slang word for a strumpet

explanation.surface: A footballer on the wing jogs towards a woman of ill repute.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Winger' suggests a footballer and 'trots' a jog; in fact the winger is a bird and Trots are Trotskyists.
explanation.definitionFit: A redstart is a small songbird, and anything with wings can be called a winger in crosswords.

clue.text: Think nothing of revealing speed

indicators.note: revealing means the letters are shown sitting inside the phrase

explanation.surface: Someone shrugs off what was revealed as nothing to worry about.
explanation.definitionFit: A knot is a unit of speed at sea, one nautical mile per hour.

clue.text: Revulsion to constituents of Anchor beer

indicators.note: the constituents of something are its parts, here the letters taken and reassembled

explanation.surface: A drinker feels disgust at what goes into a particular brand of beer.
explanation.definitionFit: Abhorrence is a feeling of disgust or loathing, a direct synonym for revulsion.

clue.text: Men cry first in hospital department in delight

indicators.note: in places the shouted pieces within the hospital department letters

parts.note: ENT is the ear, nose and throat department of a hospital

indicators.note: first puts the cry ahead of the men

parts.note: a chant is a cry or slogan
taken as written

explanation.surface: Men in a hospital department shout with joy before anyone else.
explanation.definitionFit: Enchantment is a feeling of great pleasure or charm, synonymous with delight.

clue.text: Girl had partner turning round in porch

parts.note: Vera is a girl's name

indicators.note: turning round means the pair of pieces before it are read backwards

parts.note: taken as written
N (North) is a partner at bridge

explanation.surface: A girl and her partner turned around on the porch.
explanation.definitionFit: A verandah is a roofed platform along the outside of a house, a kind of porch.

clue.text: Pals need a change by the seaside

indicators.note: a change means the letters are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: Friends who need a break head off to the coast.
explanation.definitionFit: An esplanade is a promenade, typically a level walkway along the seafront.

clue.text: Financial restriction accepted — many affected

indicators.note: accepted means the restriction word takes in the letter for many

parts.note: a cap is a limit on spending
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, so many

explanation.surface: A spending limit was agreed to, and many people felt the impact.
explanation.definitionFit: Camp means exaggerated or theatrical in manner, much like affected or mannered.

clue.text: A draw is boring — hard to swallow

parts.note: dead can mean dull or boring
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
to eat is to swallow food

explanation.surface: Someone complains that a drawn match is dull and hard to take.
explanation.definitionFit: A dead heat is a race or contest that ends level, a tie.

clue.text: Frank gives a lovebird?

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O
a pen is a female swan, a bird

explanation.surface: Someone named Frank presents a lovebird as a gift.
explanation.walkthrough: The single word 'lovebird' is split into 'love' (O) and 'bird' (a pen, a female swan); the question mark flags the split.
explanation.definitionFit: Frank and open both describe someone candid and honest in speech.

clue.text: Youth brewed green tea

indicators.note: brewed suggests stirred up, so these letters are mixed into another order

explanation.surface: A young person made a pot of green tea.
explanation.definitionFit: A teenager is a person aged thirteen to nineteen, a youth.

clue.text: A child in time embraces admirer

indicators.note: embraces means the first pair of pieces wraps around the admirer

parts.note: a fan is an admirer

explanation.surface: A child, in time, comes to hug a devoted fan.
explanation.definitionFit: An infant is a very young child, a baby.

clue.text: Girl has control on the Thames

parts.note: maiden is an old word for a girl
to head something is to lead or control it

explanation.surface: A young woman takes charge of affairs by the River Thames.
explanation.definitionFit: Maidenhead is a town in Berkshire, England, that stands on the River Thames.

clue.text: Drop speed

definitions.meaning: a drop of liquid from the eye, a teardrop
to rush or race along at great pace

explanation.definitionFit: A tear is a drop from the eye, and to tear along is to move very fast.

clue.text: German enters a flat that's lit up

indicators.note: enters means the single letter goes inside the other pieces

parts.note: low can mean flat, as in low or flat ground

explanation.surface: A German moves into an apartment that has its lights on.
explanation.definitionFit: Something aglow is shining or glowing, so lit up with light.

clue.text: Former meat producer to start to import beef

parts.note: past means former or bygone
a ram is a sheep, a producer of mutton

indicators.note: to start means only the opening letter of the next word is used

explanation.surface: A former butcher begins importing beef.
explanation.definitionFit: Pastrami is a seasoned, smoked cured beef, often served in sandwiches.

definitions.meaning: a cross-reference to another answer in the grid, a fastening made by looping cord
a cross-reference to another answer in the grid, a contest ending level

explanation.definitionFit: Tie means both to fasten cord in a loop and a contest with equal scores.

clue.text: See about hole cut in regular fashion

indicators.note: about means the see's name goes around the shortened hole word

parts.note: Ely is a cathedral city, the seat of a bishop's see

indicators.note: cut means the hole word loses its last letter

parts.note: a vent is an opening or hole

explanation.surface: Look at the cut around a hole made with a steady hand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' looks like a verb, but a see is a bishop's seat: here Ely, a cathedral city in Cambridgeshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Evenly means in a uniform, steady manner, so regularly.

clue.text: Soldier advanced? Give in!

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, standing for a soldier
lent means advanced, as of money loaned

explanation.surface: A soldier pushes forward and is told to surrender.
explanation.definitionFit: To relent is to soften and yield, much like giving in.

clue.text: Stop at nothing and hit it off when entertaining Yank

indicators.note: entertaining means hosting, so the pull word goes inside the friendship words

parts.note: got on means hit it off with someone
to tow is to pull or yank

explanation.surface: Two people who hit it off throw caution aside while hosting an American.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Yank' looks like an American; it is a verb meaning pull.
explanation.definitionFit: To go all out without restraint is an idiom for doing whatever it takes, sparing no effort.
